Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a chemical cross-linking (CXMS) study. While the prompt's modifier list does not explicitly include a 'mod_crosslinking' entry, the assay is clearly defined as such. Acquisition is DDA based on the description of trigger masses and monoisotopic peak assignment for MS2 spectra. No specific labeling strategy (like TMT or SILAC) was mentioned; it appears to be label-free.

noncellular_sources: the first data set is Human Serum Albumin (HSA)
scope: composed of 15 size exclusion chromatography fractions of Chaetomium thermophilum lysate

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study uses three public datasets. Dataset 1 is a purified protein (HSA), Dataset 2 is a pooled pseudocomplex of proteins, and Dataset 3 is a cell lysate (C. thermophilum). Per precedence rules, the most complex biological material analyzed (lysate) is used for scope, though the study is primarily a technical evaluation of search algorithms across these diverse materials.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a technical/methodological study comparing different data processing and search algorithms (MaxQuant, OpenMS, and the authors' Xi-MPA) on existing datasets. There is no biological perturbation (drug, genetic, etc.) being tested; the 'treatment' is the computational pipeline applied to the MS data. Therefore, it is mapped as un-classified.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: Data was acquired on an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos using DDA-like fragmentation (HCD, CID, ETD) and searched against databases, though the primary focus is on cross-link identification rather than standard LFQ.

modifier_candidates_ranked.reason: The entire study is dedicated to the identification of cross-linked peptides using SDA and BS3 cross-linkers.

differential: The FDR was calculated on each one of these levels: PSMs, peptide pairs, residue pairs (links) and protein pairs.
search_parameters: oxidation of methionine as variable modification
Variable modifications were monolink SDA (110.048 Da), SDA loop-links (82.0419 Da), SDA hydrolyzed (100.0524 Da), SDA oxidized (98.0368 Da)
Allowed variable modifications of the cross-linker were aminated BS3 (155.0946 Da), hydrolyzed BS3 (156.0786 Da) and loop-linked BS3 (138.0681 Da)
Carbamidomethylation on cysteine was set as fixed modification

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The study focuses on a specialized search modification (Xi-MPA) to handle monoisotopic peak misassignment in high-mass cross-linked peptides. Standard linear proteomics pipelines are insufficient; a cross-linking specific search engine is required.
